Class MQTTActivity

java.lang.Object
ecmwf.ecpds.master.MQTTActivity
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class MQTTActivity extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Bounded publication history with asynchronous database persistence, independent of telemetry admission. Payloads and connection options are deliberately never retained.
